special_traits.description: If destroyed, the mummy gains a

special_traits.name: new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points

actions.description:
The mummy makes one Rotting Fist
or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15
(2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, it gains no benefit from finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.
